answer.reason: The verses tell of Elam's king going to war against Sodom and of the LORD's word against Elam through Jeremiah.

clauses.english: fought the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah under King Chedorlaomer and took their goods
clauses.quote: they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah

clauses.english: was told by the LORD that its bow would be broken and its people scattered
clauses.quote: I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.

doubts: The second clause rests on a prophecy of judgment, not a narrated event.
Other verses (the Elamites writing against Jerusalem, Daniel's vision at Shushan, Elam among the slain) were left out as list, setting or imagery.
